value: This paper introduces the Transformer, a novel neural network architecture for sequence transduction that exclusively utilizes attention mechanisms, completely eliminating recurrent and convolutional layers. Evaluated on machine translation tasks, the Transformer demonstrates superior quality, achieving new state-of-the-art BLEU scores on WMT 2014 English-to-German (28.4) and English-to-French (41.8) datasets. Beyond its performance gains, the model offers significant benefits in training efficiency, being more parallelizable and requiring substantially less training time, and also successfully generalizes to other tasks like English constituency parsing.
